name: Seat to orbit
description: A seat confirmation for a flight to space: a ringed planet and a starfield drawn with table cells, Earth from orbit, a launch ticket and a pre-flight checklist.

settings.title: You’re on the manifest: ỌR-01, seat 4A 🚀
settings.previewText: Six seats. Sixteen sunrises a day. Confirm your seat on the first civilian flight from Lagos to orbit.

children.name: Stars
Ringed planet
Text
children.content: Adaeze, you’re one of six people on the first civilian flight from Lagos to orbit. Three days up there, sixteen sunrises a day – and the best window seat there has ever been.

children.name: Image
children.alt: Earth’s clouds and oceans seen from a spacecraft window

children.name: Text
children.content: Confirm by Friday 20 November to keep seat 4A.

children.name: Text
children.content: A half-day medical check in Victoria Island

children.name: Text
children.content: Five days of training: g-force, floating, the escape drill

children.name: Text
children.content: A fitting for your pressure suit – Ọ̀run blue or ankara print

children.name: Image
children.alt: City lights across the night side of Earth, seen from orbit

children.name: Text
children.content: You’ll pass over Lagos at night on your second orbit. Wave.
